claims.claim: An oscillation mode at 71.0 THz appears in living HEK-293T cells and living mouse kidney tissue, and similar patterns appear in mouse liver, heart and skeletal muscle and in mitochondria isolated from them
claims.evidence: FTIR spectra: the 68-72 THz peak group occurs only in the living samples, not in ground dry controls, while the known molecular vibration peaks appear in both

claims.claim: The 71 THz mode depends on intact mitochondrial structure and cannot be assigned to any specific molecule
claims.evidence: The mode disappears in ground dry samples; the authors relate it to an oscillation mode of the mitochondrion rather than a molecular vibration

claims.claim: The mode is the lower branch of a 'mito-polariton': mid-infrared light coupled to collective CH2 vibrations of cristae lipids, splitting the 87 THz CH2 mode into 71 THz (MP-) and 103 THz (MP+)
claims.evidence: Theoretical light-matter coupling model with a ~2.3 um cavity; only MP- is observed, because MP+ overlaps water vibrations

claims.claim: Weak 71.0 THz and 87.0 THz mid-infrared light raises ATP production in HEK-293T cell clusters by about 10%, while 53.7 THz does not
claims.evidence: 10 uW/mm2 for 10 min; +10.3% (p < 0.001, n = 8) and +10.1% (p < 0.01, n = 8); 53.7 THz control not significant (p > 0.05, n = 8); t-test

key_numbers.standing_wave_condition: Lm = m x lambda_m / 2 (m = 2 for HEK-293T, kidney, liver; m = 1 for heart, skeletal muscle)

frequencies.role: CH2 vibration (resonant absorption by cristae lipids)

assembly_theory_relevance.status: interpretation by the repository author; not a claim made by the paper
assembly_theory_relevance.structure_dependent_signature: Grinding and drying keeps the molecules (their known vibration peaks remain) but removes the 71 THz mode. The signal belongs to the organised, intact architecture, not to the molecular inventory. This matches the Cloud-9 premise that assembled structure carries information its parts do not.
assembly_theory_relevance.resonance: The response is frequency-specific and two-way: the structure shows a mode at 71 THz and responds to 71 THz input, while 53.7 THz at the same power does nothing. This is ordinary physical resonance, not a mystical effect.
assembly_theory_relevance.frequency_as_language: Fits the working idea of frequency as a language of structure: the more assembled the system, the more it 'says' at specific frequencies. Treated here as a heuristic for generating tests, not as a result.
assembly_theory_relevance.open_question: No assembly index was computed. A direct test would compare a structural complexity measure against the presence and strength of the 71 THz mode across preparations (intact, swollen, cristae-disrupted, ground).

tests.name: Structural Dependence
tests.detail: Signal disappears when mitochondrial structure is destroyed (ground dry samples)

tests.name: Frequency Specificity

tests.name: Polariton Model
tests.detail: Coupling strength ~16 THz (level splitting 32 THz) within the physical range used in v1 (5-25 THz)

tests.name: Cavity Resonance
tests.detail: Paper values: mitochondrial length 2.2 +/- 0.4 um vs 87 THz wavelength in mitochondria ~2.3 um (ratio ~0.96)

sandbox_validation.revision_note: These are internal plausibility checks against the paper's own numbers, not a replication. v1 used 0.5 um and 2.46 um for the cavity test and labelled 16 THz as the Rabi splitting; v2 replaces them with the paper's values (16 THz is the coupling strength, the splitting is 32 THz). The sandbox was not re-run and the PNG artifact still shows v1 inputs.

connections.detail: 71 THz is about 9 x 10^12 times the Schumann resonance (7.83 Hz) and about 4 x 10^-30 of the Planck frequency (1.85 x 10^43 Hz). v1 gave 10^12 for the Planck gap; corrected.
A ~1 kHz neural spike rate is about 1.4 x 10^-11 of 71 THz (v1 said 10^-10). The ~100 fs polariton coherence time used in v1 is an assumption; the paper does not measure coherence.
Speculative: if structured mitochondria tune energy production by resonance, metabolism has a frequency-addressable layer; no link to consciousness is tested

consciousness_universe_bridge.testable_prediction: If polariton coherence time at 310 K exceeds ~1 ps, the quantum-state interpretation strengthens; if it is far shorter, a classical vibrational-coupling explanation becomes more likely

limitations: ATP experiment uses one cell line (HEK-293T) in 3D Matrigel clusters, n = 8 per group
Only the lower branch (71 THz) is observed; the predicted 103 THz branch is masked by water vibrations
No coherence time or angle-resolved splitting measured
The paper does not report measuring sample temperature during illumination, so heating effects are not directly excluded
No animal or human experiments; nothing here supports health, wellness or device claims
v1 claim about the TCA cycle removed: it does not appear in the preprint
next_experiments: Independent replication of the FTIR signal and the ATP result, blinded
Measure sample temperature during illumination; add a sham and a heat-matched control
Frequency sweep around 71 THz to map the response curve
Graded disruption of cristae (not only grinding) to test whether the 71 THz mode scales with structural order
Isotopic substitution (13C or deuterated lipids) to shift the CH2 frequency and test the polariton model
Time-resolved spectroscopy to measure the mode's lifetime at 310 K
